scope: independent root audit of the actual selected factorizations, determinant-form step-12 recurrence, and fixed-M bounded-gap capacity theorem

mathematical_audit.actual_factors: direct multiplication over Q(i,sqrt(2)) reproduces all eight Item-321 normalized containers, and the sequences use the true Item-308 initial values
mathematical_audit.step12_recurrence: four step-12 readout rows of the true order-three companion lie in a three-dimensional state space; their signed maximal minors give the all-index Laplace identity

mathematical_audit.bounded_gap_mass: the fixed-two-form Brun/Selberg upper-bound sieve gives O(M/log^2 M) candidate-prime pairs and therefore O(M/log M)=o(M) logarithmic mass for every fixed nonzero gap
mathematical_audit.isolated_mass: the candidate-prime interval has total Chebyshev mass M/6+o(M), and deleting a finite set of bounded-gap pairs removes only o(M)
mathematical_audit.scope_warning: the rational recurrence does not prove modular propagation, a second candidate prime, or a p-unit transfer; only mechanisms whose hypotheses already require two bounded-offset prime collision rows are closed
